title: Unlucky Spawnpoints
description: This mod makes it so that no matter what you spawn in a terrible location.
body:
This mod is exactly as it sounds. No matter what you do you will spawn in a terrible location whether that be the center of the ocean, a barren island or deep underground your spawn will not make you happy. This mod is a fun way to make the beginning of your game a little more challenging and possible more rewarding, or if you hate your friends you could use it that way too.
